newsitem.title: USA: Ashland to end registration, sets repurchase.
newsitem.headline: Ashland to end registration, sets repurchase.

text.p: Ashland Inc said Monday that it will terminate a shelf registration statement providing for the offering from time to time of up to $100 million in Ashland common stock.
Ashland said in a release Monday that to date about $50 million of common stock has been sold under this program.

Ashland also said that it expects to implement a common stock repurchase program of up to one million shares of Ashland common stock annually, designed to eliminate further dilution of Ashland's stock through the operations of various company benefit programs.

Paul W. Chellgren, chief executive officer of Ashland Inc said, "Ashland has undertaken a rigorous review of its strategic direction and has been actively soliciting the views of its major investors."

Ashland said it was taking various steps to improve the company's profitability and enhance returns to its shareholders by evaluating and reducing costs, as well as reviewing alternatives for certain business units and realigning or reorganizing others.
The company said that the termination of a continuous common stock offering program and the initiation of a common stock repurchase program were in line with its program.
